// Generated companion for the private P04 navigation adaptation.
package converted

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"net/url"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"unicode"
	"unicode/utf8"

	"github.com/a-h/templ"
)

// Directory is presentation data, not an account store or permission model.
// URLs select app-owned pages. The source's inert Add button becomes a link.
type Directory struct {
	Heading, Introduction, AddLabel, EditLabel string
	NameLabel, TitleLabel, EmailLabel, RoleLabel string
	AddURL string
	Rows []DirectoryRow
}

type DirectoryRow struct { Name, Title, Email, Role, EditURL string }

// NewDirectoryNavigation validates before any output and snapshots the row slice.
// All links navigate in the same window; authorization belongs to their handlers.
// Zero rows renders the table header with an empty body, not an invented record.
// This preserves source styling, including its small targets and truncated text.
func NewDirectoryNavigation(data Directory) (templ.Component, error) {
	for _, field := range []struct { name, value string; max int }{
		{"Heading", data.Heading, 160}, {"Introduction", data.Introduction, 1200},
		{"AddLabel", data.AddLabel, 100}, {"EditLabel", data.EditLabel, 100},
		{"NameLabel", data.NameLabel, 100}, {"TitleLabel", data.TitleLabel, 100},
		{"EmailLabel", data.EmailLabel, 100}, {"RoleLabel", data.RoleLabel, 100},
	} {
		if !directoryText(field.value, field.max) { return nil, fmt.Errorf("directory: invalid %s", field.name) }
	}
	if !directoryURL(data.AddURL) { return nil, fmt.Errorf("directory: invalid AddURL") }
	if len(data.Rows) > 100 { return nil, fmt.Errorf("directory: row count exceeds 100") }
	for i, row := range data.Rows {
		if !directoryText(row.Name, 240) || !directoryText(row.Title, 240) || !directoryText(row.Email, 320) || !directoryText(row.Role, 100) || !directoryURL(row.EditURL) {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("directory: invalid row %d", i)
		}
	}
	data.Rows = append([]DirectoryRow(nil), data.Rows...)
	return directoryNavigation(data), nil
}

// A Go loop preserves exact source separators outside templ control-flow rules.
func directoryRows(data Directory) templ.Component {
	return templ.ComponentFunc(func(ctx context.Context, w io.Writer) error {
		for i, row := range data.Rows {
			if err := directoryRow(data, row).Render(ctx, w); err != nil { return err }
			if i < len(data.Rows)-1 {
				if _, err := io.WriteString(w, directoryRowSeparator); err != nil { return err }
			}
		}
		return nil
	})
}

func directoryText(s string, limit int) bool {
	if len(s) > limit || strings.TrimSpace(s) == "" || !utf8.ValidString(s) { return false }
	for _, r := range s { if unicode.IsControl(r) { return false } }
	return true
}

func directoryURL(s string) bool {
	if !directoryText(s, 2048) || strings.TrimSpace(s) != s || strings.ContainsAny(s, "\\ ") { return false }
	u, err := url.Parse(s)
	if err != nil || u.User != nil || u.Opaque != "" { return false }
	decoded, err := url.PathUnescape(s)
	if err != nil || !directoryText(decoded, 2048) || strings.Contains(decoded, "\\") { return false }
	if strings.HasPrefix(s, "/") { return !strings.HasPrefix(decoded, "//") && u.Scheme == "" && u.Host == "" }
	if port := u.Port(); port != "" {
		n, err := strconv.ParseUint(port, 10, 16)
		if err != nil || n == 0 { return false }
	}
	return strings.HasPrefix(s, "https://") && u.Scheme == "https" && u.Hostname() != "" && !strings.HasSuffix(u.Host, ":") && u.Fragment == "" && !strings.ContainsAny(u.Host, "% ")
}
